summary: Independent recalc from quarantine/orders.csv matches the eight claim values, intervals and tests the machine gate recomputed. CLM-COMPLETION-DIRECT is labelled delivered while its n=24597 and rate 0.724397 use the full direct channel (cancelled 3322, pending 3457 included). CLM-TEST-CHANNEL-AOV omits the delivered filter that its n_per_group actually uses. Both AOV estimate caveats omit delivered-only and net-of-refunds wording.
